description: SiteIQ (Studio S2) validated on SYNTHETIC cities with a hidden true demand per tract and business type. siteiq_spearman: rank correlation between SiteIQ's overall score and the true demand over the tracts SiteIQ ranks; siteiq_top5_hit_rate: share of SiteIQ's 5 best tracts that are among the 20 best tracts by true demand (out of every tract of the city). Baselines: random ranking (expected values) and the profile's single highest-weight factor used alone.
statement: Validation on SYNTHETIC cities whose generator was written by the same project author as SiteIQ. The true demand uses a different formula from SiteIQ's score (gravity decay, saturating competition, interactions, a hidden appeal field, noise), so the check is not circular, but it is not evidence of real-world accuracy.
disclaimer: Educational planning tool. Not financial, legal or lending advice. Lenders make their own decisions.

method.scoring_method: siteiq-v1: percentile rank within the metro per factor, weighted mean of the scored factors
method.weights: the profiles' DESIGN_CHOICE weights, unchanged (not tuned on the SYNTHETIC cities)
method.elapsed_note: wall-clock time on a shared machine (several agents run at once); not a benchmark

demand_estimate_spearman.note: not defined: the estimate does not vary by site (no data in the formula)
